start: fresh Pyrelands map in ordinary play, opening front lit (asserted: ProbeOpeningFront done, lit > 0)
colony vitals and pending incidents recorded
the burned share of open plantable ground (burn-stamped cells outside the suite's fire pads over fertile ground outside them) read, and the start saved (burn_line_share_start)
scenes.action: watch the front for eight game hours, capturing the front and its black trail at play zoom each hour (capture hour asserted from the game clock at each capture); save the game once while the front walks (burn_line_walking); play on to the end of day four from the start, reading the burned share and a whole-map capture at each day end; then reload burn_line_share_start with the wind setting (windCarriesFireEnabled) off and play the same four days, read the same way; then put the fire out and stage the burn line's quiet counter one step before its end, so the smoulder window ends at once
scenes.expect: burning ground whose centre moves, a growing scorched trail, and a relight in open grass after it dies; 8 hourly captures, each at its asserted hour, show grass fire moving across the map with the black trail behind it, and a judge shown them and the whole-map day-end captures confirms a natural grass fire that moves, not a flood over the whole map and not a fire that stands still; the burned share of open plantable ground grows over the four days and is never most of the map (at most half) at any day end

control.case: the same start save (burn_line_share_start) with the wind setting (windCarriesFireEnabled) off, played the same four days; and the same seed with the burn line switch (burnLineEnabled) off
control.expect: with the wind off, vanilla's even spread takes most of the map: its burned share passes half by the fourth day end, a clearly larger share than the wind-on run's (a control that does not flood leaves the read unmeasured, never passed); with the burn line off no front walks and no relight comes in the same window
control.rules_out: a share read blind to a flood passing one for the line, and a vanilla wildfire incident or a test-lit fire passing for the burn line

scenes.restore: put back the pad terrain, plants, filth and things from the snapshot taken at scene-begin, extinguish every fire the scene lit, restore the burn line and wind settings and the weather; the walking-front savegame (burn_line_walking) is kept for his review, then the disposable quicktest map is destroyed

start: a current Pyrelands map on the pyrelands tier, the bridge held; the scene saves wind_burn_live_pre before it lays a strip
four strips of ember grass on deep ash, each 61 x 21 and ringed bare, a 9-cell line marked across the wind in the middle of each, so as much grass lies upwind of it as downwind
asserted before each line is lit: SetWindForTest returned the bearing asked, ProbeWind reads that bearing back with carries= matching the wind switch, and the strip holds no fire
scenes.action: set the wind east (90) and light the first strip's line with windCarriesFireEnabled on; reverse the wind to west (270) and light the second; set it east again with the setting off and light the third; burn each 10,000 ticks, reading every 500 how far the fires reach downwind and upwind of the lit column and how many burn in the outer three lanes each side; then light the fourth strip's line under the wind and bring black rain
scenes.expect: at both bearings, east and the opposite (reversed) west, the burn runs further downwind than upwind of the lit line, so it turns when the wind turns; nothing burns in the lanes beside it and the fires at once stay a few times the cells lit; black rain puts the line out

control.case: the same line with the wind setting (windCarriesFireEnabled) off, the wind east
control.expect: the burn spreads into the outer lanes and runs both ways along the strip, leaning less than either wind run
control.rules_out: a mod that blocks sideways spread or walks one way whatever the wind (the reversed bearing), and an instrument blind to vanilla's even spread or leaning east on its own (the control)

scenes.restore: settings, weather, fires and the map's own wind bearing are put back by wind_burn_live.py; the four strips' terrain and plants are not: the map is disposable, and the save wind_burn_live_pre made at scene-begin holds the ground as it was

control.rules_out: nightfall dimming the map and ambient blowing ash banking drifts passing for ash fall's doing, and a map-wide overlay or terrain relabel applied whatever the biome, and vanilla shore terrain passing for the standing-water ring (RIMMANDRAKE_BUILD_PYRE_CONTROLS_NO_BRIDGE_TOOL_CAN_RUN removed the same-seed roster-toggle-off regeneration: sc_ash_ground left the test table; polish.md), and an ash look drawn whatever the depth (a map-wide tint) passing for the ash cover and dust

coverage_rest.why: the self-contained biome is checked where each part can fail, not by a showcase (no showcase scene uses the payload, the ports or the text): sc_populations censuses the map's own plants and cast and reads the log; biome_text_says_engineered reads the description; T_SELF_CONTAINED_OFFLINE (python3 src/RimMandrake/Pyrelands/selftest_pyrelands_self_contained.py) reads that the acoustic-scanner payload RM_AcousticPayload_Pyrelands is FindMod-guarded on the scanner's own About name and targets RM_Pyrelands and defs our mods declare, so with the scanner absent nothing applies and nothing logs; that every ported pyroclastic mutator in RM_RetiredMutatorPorts_Pyrelands is a mapped port the canon save's tiles resolve to; and that no label, description or keyed text carries campaign vocabulary (RSW_/RUT_ names, Ashkarr, Jawa, Star Wars canon words). The ports are inert until the one paint; the canon save loading their tiles with no missing-def error is a live read, UNRUN (load the canonical world save on the composed list and read Player.log for 'Could not resolve' naming an RM_ mutator)
an integration seam with nothing to see in play; a log check alone, with a listener control, covers it

every Scribe'd setting of RM_PyrelandsSettings is mapped in settings_map: a scene id means that scene's action or control turns the switch off and reads its mechanic stop (the roster toggle PyrelandsMechanicsGate and the Mod enabled master pyrelandsEnabled by sc_fire_sense's gate-off controls); T_SETTINGS_SWEEP_OFFLINE (python3 src/RimMandrake/Pyrelands/selftest_pyrelands_settings_sweep.py) reads for every setting that it is scribed once, its default equals the shipped behaviour and his ruled numbers, it is read by its mechanic outside the settings file, and every switch the master stops consults the gate; T_SITE reads the world switch ships off and labelled unsupported; T_SELF_CONTAINED_OFFLINE reads the cross-biome section's Unsupported label, and the sweep that the four cross-biome settings ship off. A setting mapped only to the sweep has its off state checked statically (read by its mechanic, behind the master), not in play; that stays inferred
